entries.question: Online Opd parcha
entries.answer:
Online registration is mandatory for all patients at KGMU. You can obtain your OPD parcha (appointment slip) using any of the following methods:

**1. Online Portal (ORS):**
*   Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
*   Select State (Uttar Pradesh) and Hospital (KGMU).
*   Click on 'New Appointment', choose your department, date, and time slot.
*   Enter patient details and pay the ₹50 fee online to download your appointment slip.

**2. Mobile App:**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **Health Care** app from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register with your mobile number and follow the same steps as the ORS portal to book your slot.

**3. SMS Booking:**
*   You can book an appointment by sending an SMS: **"APPOINTMENT <NAME>"** to **8887019134**.

**4. Walk-in (On-Site Counters):**
*   If you choose to visit the hospital directly, please bring the patient's **Aadhaar card** and an active mobile number.
*   Provide these details at the registration counter to receive an OTP, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your physical OPD slip.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **Fees:** There is a flat fee of ₹50 for the OPD slip.
*   **Timings:** OPD counters close at **1:00 PM** sharp, so it is highly recommended to arrive early or pre-book your appointment to avoid long wait times.
*   **Outside-city patients:** Please ensure you carry a valid referral letter for your specific department.

*Note: I am the KGMU AI Chatbot, created by Dr. Ayush Yadav. Please do not share sensitive personal health information, Aadhaar numbers, or phone numbers in this chat for your own safety. If you have medical concerns, please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD.*

entries.question: Is it possible blood donation today in kgmc
entries.answer:

*   **Routine Donation:** If you are planning a voluntary donation, it is best to visit during standard working hours (typically 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM on weekdays). 
*   **Verification:** I recommend calling the Transfusion Medicine department or the KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** to confirm their current availability for walk-in donors today.

**Important:** If you are feeling unwell, have symptoms of an illness, or are currently taking medication, please consult with a doctor before attempting to donate blood. entries.question: Mai radiology krna cahti hu  addmission kaise lu entrance dena pdega date ha??
entries.answer:
KGMU mein Radiology (MD Radiodiagnosis) mein admission lene ke liye aapko **NEET PG** ka entrance exam dena hota hai.

Iske baare mein mahatvapurn jaankari niche di gayi hai:

1.  **Entrance Exam:** KGMU mein Post Graduate (PG) courses, jaise ki MD Radiodiagnosis, mein admission ke liye **NEET PG** (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for Post-Graduates) qualify karna anivarya (mandatory) hai.
2.  **Admission Process:** NEET PG exam crack karne ke baad, aapko **MCC (Medical Counselling Committee)** ki counselling process mein bhag lena hoga. Admission puri tarah se aapki All India Rank (AIR) aur counselling ke aadhar par hota hai.
3.  **Dates:** NEET PG ki dates har saal National Board of Examinations (NBE) dwara ghoshit ki jaati hain. Main aapko salah dungi ki aap samay-samay par [https://natboard.edu.in/](https://natboard.edu.in/) aur [https://mcc.nic.in/](https://mcc.nic.in/) ki websites check karti rahein taaki aapko latest updates milti rahein.
4.  **KGMU Website:** Aap KGMU ki official website [www.kgmu.org](http://www.kgmu.org) par bhi 'Academic' ya 'Admission' section mein jaakar notifications check kar sakti hain.

**Ek zaruri baat:** KGMU AI CHATBOT ko Dr. Ayush Yadav (MBBS) ne banaya hai. Agar aapko medical ya health se sambandhit koi samasya hai, toh kripya kisi doctor se KGMU OPD mein paramarsh lein. Sath hi, apni suraksha ke liye is chat mein kabhi bhi apna Aadhaar number, phone number, ya koi bhi personal health details share na karein.
